openRetroItems.description: Cross-layer removal-sweep gate — BRIEF-LOE-012 panel MAJOR (orphan-after-removal). The PROGRESS.md doc-retirement sweep was scoped to 5 `.implementation/` files but PROGRESS.md had LIVE `.orchestration/` consumers; recommend a repo-wide `git grep` for any removed artifact as part of every removal task's gate.
openRetroItems.note: - **[gate-design — BRIEF-LOE-012 panel MAJOR, orphan-after-removal -> recommend a gate] Cross-layer removal-sweep.** `/pr-review` panel found that the in-task PROGRESS.md doc-retirement sweep was scoped to 5 `.implementation/` docs but missed two LIVE `.orchestration/` Conductor consumers that still hard-read the deleted `PROGRESS.md`: `orchestrate-state.sh do_derive_pr` and `orchestrate-gates.sh gate_engine_clear` (via `sequence.sh`). The owning layer's docs were swept; the cross-layer executable consumers were not. `/pr-fix babeaf0` re-pointed both onto `state.json awaitingMerge[]` (+ `--state-json` flag, fixtures, 4 test harnesses; repo-wide grep confirmed no remaining live PROGRESS.md consumer). **Lesson / recommendation:** any task that REMOVES a shared artifact (a doc, a file, a field, an exported symbol) must run a repo-wide `git grep` for ALL executable + doc consumers across EVERY layer (not just the owning layer's docs) as part of its gate -- the removal sweep scope must include cross-layer consumers. Candidate: add a `check_removed_artifact_orphans`-style gate, or a removal-task DoD checkbox requiring the repo-wide grep evidence. ENGINE/CI-tooling backlog; route to a future ungated/CI change. Not slice-blocking (resolved in-PR by `/pr-fix`).
